cs.title: Couriers
cs.sub: Courier accounts, what each one charges you, the default courier and where they pick up.
cs.empty: No courier account yet. Add one under More options.
cs.note: These are what the courier charges the shop. What the customer pays for delivery is set in Rules › Delivery.
cs.sameSetting: Same setting as Rules › Order flow.
cs.byAreaHelp: Off: one courier for everything, one pickup a day.
cs.defaultSaved: Saved — new parcels go with this courier
cs.autoHelp: When an order is packed, the parcel is booked with the default courier and the label prints. Off: staff press "Book courier" on each order.
cs.autoOn: Packed orders will be booked by themselves
cs.waiting: {n} packed orders are waiting for a courier right now.
cs.keysNote: Courier keys, payment, SMS and other services are in Keys & connections.
cs.feesHint: Used in profit for every order. Change it when the courier sends a new rate card. Needs your PIN.
cs.feesSaved: Courier fees saved — profit figures updated
cs.disconnectText: Parcels already with them keep their tracking. New parcels cannot be booked with them.
cs.isDefault: {name} is a default courier — pick another default first
cs.connectText: Courier keys are typed once in Keys & connections and stored locked; staff never see them. Until the keys pass the Test, this courier books practice parcels only. Connect switches the account on.

err.NOT_CONNECTED: This courier is not connected. Connect it first.
err.IS_DEFAULT: This courier is the default. Pick another default first.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Check the boxes and try again.
err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again later.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.network: Could not reach the server. Try again.
